name: Actuarial Science and Underwriting
blurb: How a premium gets calculated for a risk with no claims history. Automated underwriting using vision models and sensor analytics, telemetry-linked dynamic premiums, mandatory red teaming as a condition of cover, parametric payouts triggered by temperature or power thresholds, correlated accumulation modelling when one foundational model serves millions of businesses, governance maturity scoring for discounts, synthetic loss scenarios, third party safety rating agencies, and usage-based policy limits.
